verdicts.note: SEC 8-K + quartr/wnhub/outlookindia extracts: 123M DAU +10%, >29B hours, revenue ~$1.5B +36%, bookings ~$1.6B +8%, 18+ DAU +32%/hours +27%, Q3 bookings guided $1.58-1.65B (14-18% YoY decline). ~152M Q3 2025 peak not in extracts (prior knowledge 151.5M).

Quartr Q4 2025: DevEx $477M, 33.7% of revenue, +70% YoY; call summary >$1.5B creator earnings in 2025; $923M in 2024; top 1,000 averaged $1.3M (+50%). FY2025 revenue $4.9B not in extracts (prior knowledge).

Fintool/earnings commentary: standard rate rose to $0.0038 per earned Robux on Sept 5, 2025 (+8.5%). Roblox newsroom: 42% DevEx increase for age-checked US 18+ spend in eligible games from June 8, 2026. 8-K adds: effective share 26.6%->37.8%, R15 games only. Some third-party guides still list $0.0035.

$1B announced June 17, 2026 at Unreal Fest Chicago (Jan 2026 crossing per tech-insider only); 3,000+ islands earn more from in-island transactions than engagement; 40% split confirmed. Correction: 47% of player hours in May 2026 was up from 38% a year earlier, not 35%. 'In-island transactions launched January 2026' not confirmed by any extract. Extra: >75% of in-game transactions now outside Battle Royale.

Remix: The Finale (Nov 30, 2024) >14M concurrent (~14.3M per Fortnite.GG; Epic gave no exact figure), >3M streamed; Travis Scott 12.3M; Galactus ~15.3M overall record (sources split 2020/2021). Marshmello 10.7M not in extracts (prior knowledge).

Creator PLA 'Last Updated Jan. 12 2026' at fivem.net/terms; Cfx Marketplace launched same day; secondary guides: no selling virtual currency, loot boxes or items for real money. Caveat: Tebex exclusivity rests on a vendor page, not the primary PLA; a rival vendor calls Tebex only the 'default' (15% fee). Aug 11, 2023 date not in extracts (prior knowledge).

Steamcharts all-time peak 221,062 in May 2026 (SteamPulse 221,685; earlier record 202,756 on Mar 15, 2026); Steam-only count. players.com.ua: FiveM surpassed GTA 5 over a week. GTA VI Nov 19, 2026 after moves from fall 2025 to May 2026 to November (latest extract July 2026). 'Jan 2026 Steam integration' wording not confirmed.

30M registered players announced at Fan Festival Tokyo, reported Jan 8, 2024 (registered, not active). NA demolition timer resumed June 6, 2025 (relinquished plots purchasable July 22). 45-day demolition per TechRaptor/ExpertBeacon schedule (30/35/42/45 days), though Icy Veins says 30 days; Twinfinite confirms full plot price reserved on lottery bid (Guild Order says 50%). 80% refund and Apr 12, 2022 date not in extracts (prior knowledge).

IPO: Bloomberg Jan 7, 2026, confidential filing with Goldman Sachs and JPMorgan; 200M+ monthly users per a December 2025 statement (claim says April 2025). Correction: Social SDK was announced/launched in closed beta March 17, 2025; Aug 13, 2025 is when it left closed beta and opened to all developers with in-game voice/chat. Developer support article confirms global teen-by-default/age assurance in H2 2026 with no developer action expected, but the consumer rollout was first set for early March 2026, delayed after backlash, then reported live.

Naver release Mar 4, 2022: >300M registered, 20M MAU, ~95% overseas, 2M creators (not 2.83M), 68M creator items sold. Aug 2022: still 20M MAU, >5B creations, 3B item sales. Not found: 340M registered, 2.83M creators, 133,708 Korean weekly users, or any 400M figure.

additional_findings: Roblox Q3 2026 guidance: bookings $1.58-1.65B, implying a 14-18% YoY decline; no revised full-year guidance.

Roblox 8-K (Apr 30, 2026): the 42% adult-spend DevEx uplift raises effective creator share from 26.6% to 37.8% and applies only to R15-framework games (partly answers the open question on effective creator share).
Fortnite: >75% of all in-game transactions now come from experiences outside Battle Royale (Lowry, June 17, 2026); 2024 payout still quoted as both $320M and $352M.
Remix: The Finale is dated Nov 30, 2024 in all extracts, resolving the ledger's open question.
FiveM's prior 2026 record was 202,756 on March 15, 2026; Cfx Marketplace (official mod storefront) launched Jan 12, 2026, the same day as the PLA rewrite.

FFXIV: relinquished NA plots became purchasable from July 22, 2025, 45 days after the June 6 timer resumption; one fan guide (Icy Veins) states a 30-day demolition threshold, conflicting with the documented 45-day schedule.

Discord: last private valuation ~$15B (2021); a Teen Council of 10-12 members was recruited with applications open until May 2026; Social SDK studios must implement their own age-restricted-user safeguards.
Method: page fetching blocked; all verdicts rest on search-result extracts, several from secondary/aggregator sites.
